zh-CN.title: 图标加载更可靠
items: 图标字体改用稳定地址，不再受构建哈希影响
WebApp 会预加载并离线缓存完整图标字体
弱网加载失败时不再把图标名称显示成文字

en.title: More reliable icon loading
items: The icon font now uses a stable URL independent of build hashes
The WebApp preloads and caches the complete icon font offline
Icon names no longer appear as text when loading fails on weak networks
